reason: Conversation 2 reached the correct hidden truth fastest and, crucially, had the homeowner run the confirming test (towels + mat on rinse & spin), then gave a confident, accurate 'no fault, add towels' verdict with practical advice to prevent recurrence. Conversation 2 loses marks for the odd 'spin with the drum empty' suggestion and the repeated replacement-part panel/model-number nudge when no part was remotely justified, which keeps the margin slight.
